title: Zelensky still hasn't got the lesson:
text:
Zelensky still hasn't got the lesson:"

"This year we have two and a half times less interceptors than we had in 2025."

"Russia has two times more ballistic missiles per month than they had before."

"If the U.S. sells us 5%, we will go through the winter and save people’s lives. If they can sell us 10%, we will destroy all the Russian ballistic missiles."

"For today, I have 1%."
